description: t.3 starts its supervisor, whose controller t.3.sup is admitted at the next step; after its join_all t.3 spawns t.3.c1 and aborts it in the same poll, before c1 is admitted, then completes, and dropping its supervisor handle aborts t.3.sup. Rust caches the abort of c1 until its admission and then appends it to the handle-cancel queue behind the abort of t.3.sup, so t.3.sup is dispatched on the cancel lane first (dispatches 4 and 5; fuzz gen-19-24, bd-g652).
